verdict.rationale: Daytona is sandbox infrastructure for AI agents. A built-in assistant in its dashboard or CLI is a plausible feature for this kind of platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows ways for external agents to drive Daytona: an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Windsurf, an agent skill, SDKs, and programmatic Computer Use. These are integration points and building blocks, not a first-party assistant you can delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit here.
